narrative: Jaunita Hilll, 39, is built around a caloric-deficit mismatch archetype: she believes she's eating at a deficit sufficient to keep losing weight, but isn't.
Her chart shows a 23-point monthly weight trajectory — an early loss phase, then a plateau from month 9 onward.
Backdrop of obesity and asthma, managed with fluticasone and albuterol, plus an epinephrine auto-injector on file.
Also resolved histories of social isolation and intimate partner abuse victimization, and a levonorgestrel IUD for contraception.
